# p-vs-np-frontier-lab

> Machine-checked zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0 formalization of 14 unconditional complexity-barrier, polymorphism-rigidity, circuit phase-transition, and catalytic-algebra theorems (verified across 6 independent kernels), exact-arithmetic/SAT falsification bench, and 15-page AMS-LaTeX preprint auditing twelve divergent pathways toward P vs. NP. P vs. NP remains completely open.

## Key Entry Points
- [README.md](README.md): Executive summary, 5-second verbatim `#print axioms` check, statement-fidelity table, Quickstart.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Canonical instructions, Build Standard v1.2.0 hard rules (`R1`–`R8`), and one-word commands.
- [CLAIMS.md](CLAIMS.md): Complete tiered claims ledger (`C1`–`C14`, `E1`–`E10`, `O1`–`O3`).
- [LIMITATIONS.md](LIMITATIONS.md): Epistemic boundaries, timeouts, float64 disclosures, and Real vs. Metaphor.
- [REPLICATION.md](REPLICATION.md): Clean-room reproduction commands and dated replication log.
- [ERRATA.md](ERRATA.md): Append-only errata and withdrawal plan.
- [lean/Challenge.lean](lean/Challenge.lean): Human-auditable specifications of `C1`–`C14` + `AllFrontierTheoremsStmt`.
- [lean/Solution.lean](lean/Solution.lean): Zero-sorry Lean 4.35.0 proof witnesses.
- [lean/comparator.json](lean/comparator.json): 15-target 6-kernel Palomar Comparator configuration.
- [docs/statement-fidelity.md](docs/statement-fidelity.md): Line-by-line Lean-to-literature fidelity table.
- [docs/mega-atlas-cross-reference.md](docs/mega-atlas-cross-reference.md): Honest `0 / 1,900` Unsolved Problems Mega-Atlas cross-check.
- [MANIFEST.sha256](MANIFEST.sha256): Byte-exact SHA-256 provenance manifest.
